tasks.title: Audit Codebase for Dead Code
tasks.description:
Perform a comprehensive dead code analysis across the entire codebase:

1. Check all TypeScript/TSX files for:
   - Unused imports
   - Unused variables and functions
   - Unused type definitions and interfaces
   - Unreachable code paths

2. Check all CSS files for:
   - Unused CSS classes
   - Unused CSS custom properties (CSS variables)
   - Duplicate or redundant styles

3. Check all test files for:
   - Unused test helpers
   - Unused imports
   - Commented-out tests

4. Review configuration files:
   - Unused dependencies in package.json
   - Unused TypeScript compiler options
   - Unused ESLint rules

5. Use TypeScript compiler with `noUnusedLocals` and `noUnusedParameters` to identify unused code

6. If dead code is found, remove it. If none is found, document that the codebase is clean.

7. Run all tests after any removals to ensure nothing breaks.

Files to audit:
- src/App.tsx
- src/main.tsx
- src/components/Calculator.tsx
- src/components/Button.tsx
- src/components/Display.tsx
- src/App.css
- src/components/Calculator.css
- src/components/Button.css
- src/components/Display.css
- All test files (*.test.tsx)
- package.json
- tsconfig.json
- .eslintrc.json
acceptance_criteria: All source files analyzed for unused code
Any dead code identified is removed
TypeScript compiles without unused variable warnings
Documentation of findings (clean or list of removals)

tasks.title: Validate Dead Code Removal
tasks.description:
Run the complete test suite to verify that no functionality was broken during dead code removal:

1. Run `npx vitest run` to execute all tests
2. Verify all tests pass (0 failures)
3. Check that the application still builds successfully with `npm run build`
4. Confirm TypeScript compilation has no errors

If all validations pass, the dead code audit is complete.
